panel.rule: Abokin ciniki shine jarumi. Kar a taɓa ƙirƙira labari.

say: ƙin yarda shine dalilin da mai siye ke shakka: amana, farashi, bayarwa ko dacewa. Misali, takalman fata na Sade. Mutane da yawa suna amsawa, tsada sosai. Maimakon gardama, sai ta bayyana darajar: cikakken fata na saniya da ƙwanƙwalwar tafin kafa, ba manne ba.

say: An sake rubuta kwafi mai kyau. Misali, daftarin zobo na Hauwa ya fara: muna son sanar da abokan cinikinmu masu daraja. Ta yanke filler ta kara dalla-dalla: hibiscus, ginger da abarba, kwalabe 50cl, kusan naira 700 kowanne, aka kawo masu sanyi a Jos da karfe 1 na rana. Amsa ZOBO.
Daftarin nata ya tashi daga kalmomi 52 zuwa 36, kuma ya faɗi ƙari. Karanta kwafin ku da ƙarfi, kuma ku sake rubuta duk inda kuka yi tuntuɓe.
